verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI answers natural-language questions over the inbox without the user needing to remember senders or keywords, and it supports follow-up questions in a conversation. The Mail MCP connects both inbox and calendar to AI assistants, and Ask AI is exposed through it. Several parts of the story are not documented, so coverage is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: evidence that answers are grounded with source citations or links back to messages, explicit cross-inbox-and-calendar Q&A inside Ask AI itself, 'what's outstanding' / 'who said what' style querying, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.
You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
